## DATA IS OUR SUPERPOWER

MediKarma bridges the gap between clinical intent and daily action.

 

We fuse Frictionless EMR with Real-Time Biometrics to predict risks with 90.6% validated accuracy.

[over-Blk.jpg]

### YOUR DIGITAL TWIN

You can't fix what you can't see. We create a living, breathing digital twin of your body, updated
in real-time by your clinical and wearable data.


We replace confusing lab reports with a dynamic 'Traffic Light' visualization (Green/Yellow/Red),
instantly highlighting organ-specific risks so users know exactly where to focus their efforts.

[Avatar.jpg]

### REAL-TIME HEALTH SCORE

You can't improve what you don't measure – that's why our AI engine correlates thousands of live and
historical health records to give you an objective assessment of your health that is clinically
proven to correlate with 90.6% of future health risks and costs.

[Score.jpg]

### POWERED BY DUAL-AI ARCHITECTURE

Bridging the Gap Between Patient Engagement and Enterprise Intelligence.


We solve healthcare’s disconnect with a unified dual-agent system. Jill AI engages the patient 24/7,
generating the real-time data that Jack AI uses to empower care teams—creating a continuous,
intelligent feedback loop.

 

Jill (The Personal Health Agent): Acting as a 24/7 "health engagement engine," Jill transforms
passive patients into active participants. She uses Conversational AI and Behavioral Nudges (based
on the COM-B Model) to guide daily decisions – from medication adherence to lifestyle choices –
delivering personalized micro-coaching that maintains high engagement between clinical visits.

 

Jack (The Enterprise Intelligence): Jack AI is MediKarma's patented EMR infrastructure that
retrieves complete, nationwide patient medical histories in ~120 seconds using only Name, Date of
Birth and Zip Code – eliminating the portal logins and provider consent delays that plague
healthcare data access. Jack instantly aggregates records across all providers, normalizes
fragmented data into a unified longitudinal view and delivers actionable patient intelligence to
care teams. No portals. No consent bottlenecks. No waiting.

> "This partnership makes timely care access real. We're giving members the tools to enhance
> wellness and physician collaboration – making healthcare more accessible for everyone."

Carlos Perez, CEO

Family Health Choice, FL

[multi-ethnicities-various-people-face-portraits_edited.jpg]

## WHY MEDIKARMA

Powered by Cognitive Science.

Most apps nag you. MediKarma understands you. By using Anticipatory Intelligence and behavioral
science algorithms, we deliver the right nudge at the exact moment you are ready to act, driving 35%
monthly engagement  compared to the industry average of <5%.

PureBulk was founded in 2008 by Timothy McNulty in Missoula, Montana, beginning with a simple idea:
to provide customers with high-quality dietary supplements without the unnecessary fillers, all at
an affordable price. The company’s journey started on eBay, where it quickly gained traction among
health-conscious consumers.

In 2009, PureBulk moved to Oregon to accommodate its growing demand, but the company soon outgrew
its new location. By 2010, PureBulk found its permanent home in Roseburg, Oregon, where it continues
to thrive. Today, the company proudly employs over 40 people in the stunning Pacific Northwest,
committed to delivering pure, transparent products to customers nationwide.

OUR STORY

PureBulk was founded in 2008 by Timothy McNulty in Missoula, Montana, beginning with a simple idea:
to provide customers with high-quality dietary supplements without the unnecessary fillers, all at
an affordable price. The company’s journey started on eBay, where it quickly gained traction among
health-conscious consumers.

In 2009, PureBulk moved to Oregon to accommodate its growing demand, but the company soon outgrew
its new location. By 2010, PureBulk found its permanent home in Roseburg, Oregon, where it continues
to thrive. Today, the company proudly employs over 40 people in the stunning Pacific Northwest,
committed to delivering pure, transparent products to customers nationwide.

## Delivering Excellence Through Science With Quality, Trust And Innovation.

### APIs

We produce high-quality, reliable APIs like antibiotics, antidiabetics, and anti-inflammatories with
GMP certified plants and global regulatory compliance.

### Intermediates

Our broad range of intermediates such as fluoroquinolones and nitroimidazoles supports complex API
development with scalable, R&D backed solutions.

### Specialty Chemicals

We offer Salicylic Acid, Trimethylamine, Dimethylamine, Monomethylamine, Benzene Sulphonyl Chloride,
and Methyl Nicotinate.

### Amines

Our broad range of intermediates such as fluoroquinolones and nitroimidazoles supports complex API
development with scalable, R&D backed solutions.

### Contract Manufacture

Our broad range of intermediates such as fluoroquinolones and nitroimidazoles supports complex API
development with scalable, R&D backed solutions.

About

## AARTI DRUGS LTD.

Aarti Drugs Ltd. was established in the year 1984 and forms part of $900 Million Aarti Group of
Industries with robust R&D Division at Tarapur, Maharashtra Industrial Development Corporation
(MIDC) in close vicinity to manufacturing locations.
* The Company is engaged in the manufacturing of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs), Pharma
  Intermediates, Specialty Chemicals and also produces Formulations with its wholly-owned subsidiary
  – Pinnacle Life Science Private Limited.
* Products under APIs includes Ciprofloxacin Hydrochloride, Metronidazole, Metformin HCL,
  Ketoconazole, Ofloxacin etc. whereas Specialty Chemicals includes Salicylic acid, Trimethylamine,
  Dimethylamine, Monomethylamine, Benzene Sulphonyl Chloride, Methyl Nicotinate etc.

## **Pharmaceutical Manufacturers in India**

**Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.** is emerging as a leader in pharmaceutical manufacturing,
exporting, and supplying from India.

“Innovate and automate, with human touch in manufacturing process to provide affordable
pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished
formulations][64] that cater to the most demanding global needs. We are on the verge of becoming one
of the largest pharmaceutical companies in India when it comes to [contract manufacturing][65] of
[Tablets][66], [Capsules][67], [Injections][68],[Creams/Ointments][69], [Drops][70], [Infusion][71],
[Inhaler][72], [Lotion][73], [Gel][74], [Suspension / syrup][75], [Nasal Drops/Sprays][76], etc.  

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

## **These are Some of the Key Features of Our Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Plant:**
* The continuous and uninterrupted flow of Process & Facilities that comply with Schedule “M”
  Specifications & **WHO-GMP **norms.
* Effective sanitation and fully automated HVAC System.
* Facility to manufacture every variety of tablets including un-coated, film-coated, double-layered,
  sugar-coated, enteric coated and slow release tablets.
* VAHP chillers that are 100% environment friendly.
* Duo Pass Reverse Osmosis water system/ de-mineralization plant.
* Multi-Stage Distillation plant.
* De-Humidification unit and dust extraction systems and separate AHUs for each zone.
* Zone-wise segregation of every critical processing activity, to prevent cross-contamination
* Even uniforms are marked with zone-specific colors to ensure complete segregation.
* Isolated and dedicated facilities for producing B-Lactam and Cephalosporin dosage forms.
* Area-specific Air Environment Conditioning with respect to temperature, pressure, humidity,
  filtration, etc.
* Zero-discharge Effluent Treatment Plant.
* Alternative power generation system to ensure uninterrupted production and Separate air handling
  units for each production department.
* In house R&D facility with experienced and talented researchers.

All the above-mentioned facilities are **[WHO, GMP certified and ISO 9001][79]** accredited for
systems. Regular global audits are conducted to further uplift our standards.

As a result, we have grown into leading pharmaceutical drug manufacturers over the years. With the
goodwill and trust of our customers, the best is yet to come!

packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

## **These are Some of the Key Features of Our Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Plant:**
* The continuous and uninterrupted flow of Process & Facilities that comply with Schedule “M”
  Specifications & **WHO-GMP **norms.
* Effective sanitation and fully automated HVAC System.
* Facility to manufacture every variety of tablets including un-coated, film-coated, double-layered,
  sugar-coated, enteric coated and slow release tablets.
* VAHP chillers that are 100% environment friendly.
* Duo Pass Reverse Osmosis water system/ de-mineralization plant.
* Multi-Stage Distillation plant.
* De-Humidification unit and dust extraction systems and separate AHUs for each zone.
* Zone-wise segregation of every critical processing activity, to prevent cross-contamination
* Even uniforms are marked with zone-specific colors to ensure complete segregation.
* Isolated and dedicated facilities for producing B-Lactam and Cephalosporin dosage forms.
* Area-specific Air Environment Conditioning with respect to temperature, pressure, humidity,
  filtration, etc.
* Zero-discharge Effluent Treatment Plant.
* Alternative power generation system to ensure uninterrupted production and Separate air handling
  units for each production department.
* In house R&D facility with experienced and talented researchers.

All the above-mentioned facilities are **[WHO, GMP certified and ISO 9001][79]** accredited for
systems. Regular global audits are conducted to further uplift our standards.

As a result, we have grown into leading pharmaceutical drug manufacturers over the years. With the
goodwill and trust of our customers, the best is yet to come!

### Athens, Greece

With more than 3,000 sqm of R&D facilities, our team in Athens specialises in the development of
Value Added Medicines and has been recently upgraded with HPAPI capabilities.

⟶][121]
[[flag][flag]

### Halden, Norway

Halden is one of the largest and most advanced sterile production facilities in Northern Europe. It
specialises in the production and distribution of IV bags and plastic ampoules using Blow-Fill Seal
(BFS) technology.

⟶][122]
[[flag][flag]

### Jura, Switzerland

We provide a complete range of services tailored to both Clinical Manufacturing and Commercial
Manufacturing needs, and we specialise in small-batch production with a customised approach.  

⟶][123]
[[flag][flag]

### Kawagoe, Japan

Our state-of-the-art manufacturing site specialises in ampoules, tablets and visual inspection
services. We offer excellent customer service in English and Japanese. It has one of the largest
cold storage warehouses in Japan.

⟶][124]
[[flag][flag]

### Livron, France

With over 100 years of experience, Adragos Livron focuses on sterile liquids and suppositories
manufacturing. We handle more than 100 molecules and provide stability studies, narcotics handling
and analytical testing services.

⟶][125]
[[flag][flag]

### Leipzig, Germany

Our manufacturing facility in Leipzig specialises in semi-solid and non-sterile liquid
pharmaceuticals. With over 100 years of experience, we have a track record of providing first-class
service and customer-focused manufacturing.

⟶][126]
[[flag][flag]

### Maisons-Alfort, France

At our facility in France, we manufacture sterile prefilled syringes and liquid or lyophilised
vials.
With high-speed aseptic filling, freeze-drying, and integrated packaging, the site uses
GMP-compliant CIP/SIP and RABS technologies to ensure quality and reliable global supply.

Our global presence as a CDMO spans across seven locations around the world, simplifying

[[flag][flag]

### Athens, Greece

With more than 3,000 sqm of R&D facilities, our team in Athens specialises in the development of
Value Added Medicines and has been recently upgraded with HPAPI capabilities.

⟶][121]
[[flag][flag]

### Halden, Norway

Halden is one of the largest and most advanced sterile production facilities in Northern Europe. It
specialises in the production and distribution of IV bags and plastic ampoules using Blow-Fill Seal
(BFS) technology.

⟶][122]
[[flag][flag]

### Jura, Switzerland

We provide a complete range of services tailored to both Clinical Manufacturing and Commercial
Manufacturing needs, and we specialise in small-batch production with a customised approach.  

⟶][123]
[[flag][flag]

### Kawagoe, Japan

Our state-of-the-art manufacturing site specialises in ampoules, tablets and visual inspection
services. We offer excellent customer service in English and Japanese. It has one of the largest
cold storage warehouses in Japan.

⟶][124]
[[flag][flag]

### Livron, France

With over 100 years of experience, Adragos Livron focuses on sterile liquids and suppositories
manufacturing. We handle more than 100 molecules and provide stability studies, narcotics handling
and analytical testing services.

⟶][125]
[[flag][flag]

### Leipzig, Germany

Our manufacturing facility in Leipzig specialises in semi-solid and non-sterile liquid
pharmaceuticals. With over 100 years of experience, we have a track record of providing first-class
service and customer-focused manufacturing.

⟶][126]
[[flag][flag]

### Maisons-Alfort, France

At our facility in France, we manufacture sterile prefilled syringes and liquid or lyophilised
vials.
With high-speed aseptic filling, freeze-drying, and integrated packaging, the site uses
GMP-compliant CIP/SIP and RABS technologies to ensure quality and reliable global supply.

worldwide, Akums is committed to delivering groundbreaking formulations that meet evolving market
needs.

reinforce our leadership in pharmaceutical manufacturing.

## Akums Drugs and Pharmaceuticals Ltd.: Leading the Way in Pharma Manufacturing

▼

Akums Drugs & Pharmaceuticals Ltd. stands as India’s largest and most trusted Contract Development
and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), redefining pharmaceutical excellence through innovation,
quality, and efficiency. As a preferred partner for leading pharmaceutical and healthcare companies
worldwide, Akums is committed to delivering groundbreaking formulations that meet evolving market
needs.

With 15+ state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities, Akums offers unmatched expertise across diverse
therapeutic segments and dosage forms, including tablets, capsules, injectables, soft gels, syrups,
topicals, nutraceuticals, cosmeceuticals, derma solutions etc. Our robust R&D capabilities drive
innovation, ensuring fast, cost-effective product development that aligns with stringent regulatory
standards.

Akums is also a trusted leader in Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API) manufacturing, ensuring a
seamless and high-quality supply of essential raw materials for pharmaceutical formulations. Our API
capabilities are in compliance with international regulatory standards, supporting the development
of superior formulations while enhancing supply chain reliability for our partners.

Quality at Akums is more than a benchmark—it is a culture. We adhere to global regulatory standards,
including WHO-GMP, USFDA, EU-GMP, and TGA, ensuring that every product meets the highest safety and
efficacy standards. Our advanced Quality Management System (QMS) and compliance-driven approach
reinforce our leadership in pharmaceutical manufacturing.

Akums collaborates with 1500+ pharmaceutical companies, manufacturing over 4100+ commercialized
formulations. Our expertise extends beyond manufacturing to include formulation development,
technology transfers, regulatory support, and customized solutions, helping brands expand their
portfolios and market presence seamlessly.

While innovation fuels our growth, sustainability shapes our future. Akums integrates eco-friendly
initiatives and energy-efficient manufacturing processes, ensuring responsible business operations
that contribute to a healthier planet.

Leading the Make in India initiative, Akums continues to revolutionize global healthcare by
providing high-quality, innovative pharmaceutical solutions with a patient-first approach,
strengthening its position as a driving force in the industry.

Journey

## A story of helping fight diseases better

[See our entire journey][139]
1907
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey beginning in 1907]

Started manufacturing tinctures and alcohol at Vadodara

1940
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1940]

Began production of cough syrups, vitamins, tonics and sulphur drugs

1961
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1961]

Inaugurated Penicilin plant with Lal Bahadur Shastri in attendance

1967
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1967]

Initiated bulk manufacturing of Vitamin B12

1971
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1971]

Manufactured Erythromycin for the first time in Indian history

1972
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1972]

Launched Althrocin, a brand of Erythromycin

1997
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1997]

Althrocin moves to become top selling brand in India

1999
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1999]

Kickstarted the production of synthetic, organic API

2000
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2000]

Received ISO 14000 certification for facilities at Vadodara

2001
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2001]

Began production of Cephalosporin C

2007
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2007]

Acquired non-oncology business of M/s Dabur Pharma Ltd.

2009
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2009]

Addressed chronic therapies through multiple marketing divisions

2011
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2011]

Demerged from Alembic group to form Alembic Pharmaceutical Ltd, and gets listed

2012
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2012]

Unveiled the Dematology division in domestic market with 8 products

2013
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2013]

Started first NDA with a partner and commenced filing in EU, Australia and Brazil

2015
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2015]

Launched Aripiprazole and established the US Front-end as also transitioning to in-house marketing
in the US

2016
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2016]

Struck a JV with Orbicular – Aleor Dermaceutical Limited to develop dermatology products for the
international market

2017

[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Inaugurated the manufacturing facility for Oncology medicines, including oral solids and liquid
injectable vials, in the presence of the Hon’ble Chief Minister of Gujarat, Shri. Vijay Rupani

2017
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Acquired Orit Laboratories LLC, USA

2018
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2018]

Received FDA approvals for Aleor’s dermatology facility

2019
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2019]

Granted approvals for Oncology oral solid facility

Entered a JV to foray into the China market

2020
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2020]

Achieved the milestone of US$ 250 million sales in the US frontend

[5 Strategies to Reduce AI Hallucination in Clinical Research by Seong min Cho]

#### 5 Strategies to Reduce AI Hallucination in Clinical Research by Seong min Cho

Learn 5 practical strategies to reduce AI hallucination in clinical research to improve accuracy,
transparency, compliance, and decision-making.

[Read now! ][17]

[A Day in the Life of A Molecule]

#### A Day in the Life of A Molecule

Press play to meet Mike the Molecule—he’s got big dreams and a big journey ahead! Follow along as he
takes on every stage of drug development here at Altasciences.Science has never been this fun!

[Learn more! ][18]

[A Day in the Life of a Veterinary Scientist, Ophthalmology]

#### A Day in the Life of a Veterinary Scientist, Ophthalmology

Marianna Bacellar-Galdino has always loved scientific research, and after a particularly eye-opening
project in veterinary school, ophthalmology became the thread connecting all her scientific
interests—and eventually her whole career.

[Watch now! ][19]

We are a forward-thinking, mid-size early phase contract research organization, in Canada and the
U.S., offering biopharmaceutical companies of all sizes a proven, flexible approach to early drug
development, including preclinical safety testing, clinical pharmacology (Phase I to Phase II),
bioanalysis (preclinical to Phase IV), research services, and manufacturing and analytical services.

Focused on your success … always available and always looking ahead ... moving in unison to deliver
big impact with a personal touch.

## WHAT WE DO

We help you reach early phase drug development decision-making milestones sooner, improving speed
and ease from lead candidate selection to proof of concept, and beyond.
* [ [Preclinical Services] ][20]
  
  #### [ **ALTA**SCIENCES Preclinical Services ][21]

## Our vision is to be a leading global rare disease company by acquiring, developing and
## commercialising medicines that transform the lives of patients & their families around the world.

## About

At Amryt Pharma, we look beyond the ordinary, unearthing scientific potential and delivering
medicines that may have the potential to change the lives of people with rare, debilitating
conditions. Through our in-depth knowledge and bold approach we combine the expertise and innovation
needed to help patients and their caregivers to access new treatments quickly and responsibly.

[READ MORE][89]

### [Amryt Compliance][90]
### [Aegerion Consent Decree][91]

## Advocacy

Amryt Pharma supports the aims and objectives of advocacy groups working across rare and
debilitating diseases to help patients and their families and carers.

[READ MORE][92]

## Join us

This is an exciting time for Amryt Pharma. We are a successful, thriving global company poised to
achieve unparalleled results. Our success is driven and defined by the inspiring people who embody
our values and wake up every day with the goal of changing lives of people with rare and
debilitating diseases.

[GET IN TOUCH][93]

#  

 

 

 

 

#  The latest innovation in capsaicin

A breakthrough natural analogue solution for weight control, better gut health and sport nutrition 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

# Pure efficiency for improving health naturally

The health benefits of chili, with its active ingredient capsaicin, are proven in science.
aXivite’s active ingredient is Phenylcapsaicin, a patented natural analogue of capsaicin. It reduces
body weight and fights obesity. It increases metabolism and lowers energy intake. And it
balances intestinal flora and reduces gut inflammation.


#### Safe

aXivite is safe to use with a purity of 98%. It is free of contaminants and according to several
studies, Phenylcapsaicin shows no sign of genotoxicity. This makes aXivite safe for long-term use.
It is authorised in Europe as a Novel Food under the Novel Food legislation and as GRAS Food in the
US.

#### Versatile

With the unique microencapsulation, the pungency of capsaicin is controlled. It is engineered for a
specific release and since the dosage can be versioned  the usage is very versatile. It also
facilitates a standardised and large-scale production for a cost-efficient and stable delivery.

#### Effective

With its high bioavailability, aXivite® delivers much greater plasma concentration at the same
dosage compared to natural capsaicin. This allows for a much lower quantity needed, making aXivite®
a cost-efficient, practical, and safe alternative to naturally extracted capsaicin.

#### Bioenhancer

Accelerates the nutrition uptake. Scientifically verified, it facilitates a healthy and quick uptake
of ingredients, e.g. curcumin. Compared to natural capsaicin, the bioenhancement effect is superior
and microencapsulation enhances absorption improving the nutrient uptake.

# What do we do?

aXivite is based on an innovative molecule «Phenyl-capsaicin» which is an analogue to
capsaicin. Phenylcapsaicin is a proprietary molecule  where a naturally occurring phenyl group has
been used to stabilize nature identical capsaicin.  Bridged by a triple bond, the result is an
innovative natural analogue capsaicin with high purity, where the pungency is greatly reduced.

 

[Learn more][30]

# Improving health naturally

#### aXivite can be used for weight control and treating high blood pressure. It is also known to
#### ease irritation in the gut and promote healthy gut microbiota. Studies show that capsaicin
#### consumption has proved to reduce body weight and has the potential to treat anti-obesity.
#### Recognised as a bioenhancer, its bioavailability is much higher than natural capsaicin. It also
#### works to prevent microbial dysbiosis, gut barrier dysfunction and chronic low-grade
#### inflammation.

[Learn more][31]

# Our latest studies

aXivite is the result of extensive research with proven positive health benefits for improving human
health in line with nature. Several studies prove its efficiency in areas such as weight loss, gut
health and sport nutrition. In some cases its advantages even exceeds natural capsaicin.

aXivite is safe to use with a purity of 98%. It is free of contaminants and according to several
studies, Phenylcapsaicin shows no sign of genotoxicity. This makes aXivite safe for long-term use.
It is authorised in Europe as a Novel Food under the Novel Food legislation and as GRAS Food in the

With the unique microencapsulation, the pungency of capsaicin is controlled. It is engineered for a

facilitates a standardised and large-scale production for a cost-efficient and stable delivery.

With its high bioavailability, aXivite® delivers much greater plasma concentration at the same
dosage compared to natural capsaicin. This allows for a much lower quantity needed, making aXivite®
a cost-efficient, practical, and safe alternative to naturally extracted capsaicin.

Accelerates the nutrition uptake. Scientifically verified, it facilitates a healthy and quick uptake
of ingredients, e.g. curcumin. Compared to natural capsaicin, the bioenhancement effect is superior
and microencapsulation enhances absorption improving the nutrient uptake.

# What do we do?

aXivite is based on an innovative molecule «Phenyl-capsaicin» which is an analogue to
capsaicin. Phenylcapsaicin is a proprietary molecule  where a naturally occurring phenyl group has
been used to stabilize nature identical capsaicin.  Bridged by a triple bond, the result is an
innovative natural analogue capsaicin with high purity, where the pungency is greatly reduced.

## Blooming Q&A

### What is the best flower shop near me in Seattle?

If you’re looking for the best flower shop near you in Seattle, look no further than Ballard Blossom
Inc! We are known for offering a wide selection of fresh, high-quality flowers and exceptional
customer service. Whether you need a stunning bouquet of roses, seasonal flowers like sunflowers and
tulips, or a custom arrangement for a special occasion, we’ve got you covered. Conveniently located
in the heart of Seattle, we pride ourselves on delivering beautiful blooms for all occasions, from
weddings to birthdays, anniversaries, and holidays like Mother’s Day and Valentine’s Day. Visit us
today or order online for fast, local delivery!

### Does Ballard Blossom Inc in Seattle offer same-day flower delivery?

Yes, Ballard Blossom Inc in Seattle proudly offers same-day flower delivery on all orders. Whether
you’re looking to send a beautiful bouquet for a birthday, anniversary, or special occasion, we
ensure your flowers arrive fresh and on time. Place your order today and enjoy the convenience of
fast, local delivery!

### What are the best flowers to send for a birthday from Ballard Blossom Inc in Seattle?

At Ballard Blossom Inc in Seattle, we offer a variety of birthday flowers that are perfect for
making any celebration special. Our most popular birthday blooms include vibrant sunflowers,
cheerful daisies, elegant roses, and colorful carnations. For a more personalized touch, we also
offer mixed arrangements with seasonal flowers like lilies, tulips, and orchids. Order today and let
us deliver a fresh, handpicked bouquet straight to your loved one’s door!

### What flowers are best for a funeral or sympathy arrangement from Ballard Blossom Inc in Seattle?

At Ballard Blossom Inc in Seattle, we understand the importance of sending thoughtful flowers during
difficult times. Our sympathy arrangements often include elegant lilies, white roses, soft
carnations, and peace lilies, which convey comfort and respect. We can also create custom
arrangements to honor your loved one’s memory with seasonal flowers like hydrangeas or orchids. Shop
online or call us to discuss your needs, and we’ll ensure your sympathy flowers are delivered to
your recipient's home, local church, funeral home or cemetery with care and compassion.

### What are the best flowers to send for holidays like Mother’s Day, Valentine’s Day, Easter,
### Halloween, Christmas, Thanksgiving, and more from a florist in Seattle?

At Ballard Blossom Inc in Seattle, we offer stunning floral arrangements for every holiday and
season throughout the year. For Mother’s Day, brighten mom’s day with vibrant roses, delicate
lilies, and colorful tulips. On Valentine’s Day, classic red roses, romantic peonies, and exotic
orchids are perfect for expressing love. For Easter, our spring favorites like lilies, daffodils,
and tulips bring the season’s beauty to life. Celebrate Halloween with bold orange and black blooms
like marigolds, sunflowers, and dark roses. For Christmas, our festive floral designs include
poinsettias, evergreen wreaths, and red and white roses to add holiday cheer to your home. For
Thanksgiving, we offer autumn-inspired arrangements with chrysanthemums, sunflowers, and

If you’re looking for the best flower shop near you in Seattle, look no further than Ballard Blossom
Inc! We are known for offering a wide selection of fresh, high-quality flowers and exceptional
customer service. Whether you need a stunning bouquet of roses, seasonal flowers like sunflowers and
tulips, or a custom arrangement for a special occasion, we’ve got you covered. Conveniently located
in the heart of Seattle, we pride ourselves on delivering beautiful blooms for all occasions, from
weddings to birthdays, anniversaries, and holidays like Mother’s Day and Valentine’s Day. Visit us
today or order online for fast, local delivery!

### Does Ballard Blossom Inc in Seattle offer same-day flower delivery?

Yes, Ballard Blossom Inc in Seattle proudly offers same-day flower delivery on all orders. Whether
you’re looking to send a beautiful bouquet for a birthday, anniversary, or special occasion, we
ensure your flowers arrive fresh and on time. Place your order today and enjoy the convenience of
fast, local delivery!

### What are the best flowers to send for a birthday from Ballard Blossom Inc in Seattle?

At Ballard Blossom Inc in Seattle, we offer a variety of birthday flowers that are perfect for
making any celebration special. Our most popular birthday blooms include vibrant sunflowers,
cheerful daisies, elegant roses, and colorful carnations. For a more personalized touch, we also
offer mixed arrangements with seasonal flowers like lilies, tulips, and orchids. Order today and let
us deliver a fresh, handpicked bouquet straight to your loved one’s door!

### What flowers are best for a funeral or sympathy arrangement from Ballard Blossom Inc in Seattle?

At Ballard Blossom Inc in Seattle, we understand the importance of sending thoughtful flowers during
difficult times. Our sympathy arrangements often include elegant lilies, white roses, soft
carnations, and peace lilies, which convey comfort and respect. We can also create custom
arrangements to honor your loved one’s memory with seasonal flowers like hydrangeas or orchids. Shop
online or call us to discuss your needs, and we’ll ensure your sympathy flowers are delivered to
your recipient's home, local church, funeral home or cemetery with care and compassion.

### What are the best flowers to send for holidays like Mother’s Day, Valentine’s Day, Easter,
### Halloween, Christmas, Thanksgiving, and more from a florist in Seattle?

At Ballard Blossom Inc in Seattle, we offer stunning floral arrangements for every holiday and
season throughout the year. For Mother’s Day, brighten mom’s day with vibrant roses, delicate
lilies, and colorful tulips. On Valentine’s Day, classic red roses, romantic peonies, and exotic
orchids are perfect for expressing love. For Easter, our spring favorites like lilies, daffodils,
and tulips bring the season’s beauty to life. Celebrate Halloween with bold orange and black blooms
like marigolds, sunflowers, and dark roses. For Christmas, our festive floral designs include
poinsettias, evergreen wreaths, and red and white roses to add holiday cheer to your home. For

## Questions, answered

Everything you need to know about sourcing, shipping, and running your store with Commercive.

What is Commercive, and what do you actually do?

We source, store, pick, pack, and ship your orders from both China and the US, and we run sourcing
and manufacturing too. One partner takes your product from the factory floor to your customer’s
doorstep, so there’s no gap between sourcing and fulfillment where orders get lost.

How fast will my customers get their orders?

US orders typically arrive in 1 to 3 days from our US facilities, and global orders land in roughly
5 to 8 days from China. We ship to 65+ countries directly, reach 100+ in total, and route each order
through the fastest reliable line for its destination.

Will my customers know the order shipped from China?

No. Tracking is masked and branded end to end, so from the confirmation email to the tracking page
your customer sees your brand, not a China origin or a third-party label. It protects your
positioning and cuts the support tickets that come with obvious overseas shipping.

Can I ship from the US instead of China?

Yes. We run US 3PL alongside China, so you can hold stock stateside and fulfill domestic orders in 1
to 3 days. Many brands split it, keeping bestsellers in the US for speed and using China for
testing, restocks, and global reach, all from one dashboard.

Can you source products for me, or do I need a supplier first?

We can source for you. We work with 1,845+ vetted factory partners across China, so bring a product
idea or a link and we’ll find and vet the manufacturer. Because we source and fulfill in one
operation, the product goes straight from the factory into your orders with no middleman markup.

Is there a minimum order quantity?

No, there’s no MOQ. You can start small, test a product, and scale once it proves out without
gambling on a large first run, and when it takes off our factory network lets you scale fast.

How much can I actually save with Commercive?

Clients typically save 30 to 40 percent on fulfillment versus what they were paying. It comes from
direct factory relationships with no middleman markup, efficient shipping across 65+ countries, and
free storage instead of monthly warehouse fees, and a quote shows the exact number for your volume.

What does the Commercive dashboard show me?

Your orders, inventory, tracking, and invoices, all in one place and updated live. Watch orders move
from placed to packed to shipped, follow tracking for every parcel, and pull invoices without
emailing anyone, so it’s the single source of truth for your operation.

How do I start working with you?

Get a free quote. Tell us your products, order volume, and where you ship, and we come back with
pricing and a plan built on your real numbers, then connect your store so orders flow to us
automatically. Most of the setup is on our side.

FAQ
[ What is Detoxamin?
][51]

Detoxamin EDTA Chelation Suppositories are a powerful and complete program and fits in with today’s
“on the go” lifestyle. Detoxamin's effectiveness is documented in published medical studies, it’s
more than 70% less than IV chelation, and the most preferred home chelation method in the world.
Detoxamin utilises the power of Ca-EDTA, having the longest track record for safety and
effectiveness. With scientific proof of bioavailability & absorption superior to even that of IV
chelation.

Ca-EDTA has become as essential for health as an essential nutrient, and it appears to offer
potential benefits as diverse as those seen with some essential nutrients, suggesting we all carry a
greater burden of toxic metals than is in our best interest for achieving either optimal health or
our maximum intended useful lifespan.

Detoxamin EDTA Chelation Suppositories are scientifically and clinically proven to support
cardiovascular and bone health, healthy brain and neurological function, helps to diminish the aging
process and so much more.

[ Why use Glutathione?
][52]

Aging Defence: People who live to into their 80s and beyond are found to have higher levels of
glutathione. Often called the “master” antioxidant, glutathione boosts the utilization and recycling
of other antioxidants, namely vitamins C and E, as well as alpha lipoic acid and CoQ10. Low levels
of glutathione send messages to trigger apoptosis, or cell death. The critical role glutathione
plays at the cellular and mitochondrial levels, the overall health and longevity benefits are vast
and wide. Long story short, the more glutathione you have in your body, the healthier your cells and
mitochondria. Both EDTA and Glutathione are poorly absorbed when taken orally. But now, with this
powerful formula, you can get all the powerful benefits of both EDTA and Glutathione at the highest
level. You see, bio-availability is the key to performance.

[ Is Detoxamin Proven and Safe?
][53]

Detoxamin's EDTA is bio-equivalent and medically similar to IV EDTA and much better then the poorly
absorbed oral chelation. With significant and efficient long-lasting EDTA blood levels and
three-fold EDTA tissue saturation it enables more efficient deep tissue heavy metal clearance.
Detoxamin EDTA Suppositories are backed by four scientific and clinical studies that have clearly
proven scientifically its safety and medical similarity to IV EDTA chelation.

These carefully monitored clinical trials revealed no significant adverse effects either reported by
patients or within blood chemistry panels of those in the studies. The researchers state that the
dosage form is gentle and appears to create little biological burden and is very well tolerated. To
date, millions of doses have been administered worldwide.

[ Who should not use Detoxamin?
][54]

Detoxamin should not be taken during pregnancy or breast feeding.

[ What is Hygeena?
][55]

Hygeena Vaginal Suppositories are truly an elixir for vaginal health. It can help women regain
sexual pleasure as well as vaginal health. Hygeena’s unique formula incorporating Pueraria Mirifica,
Hyaluronic Acid, SilverBiotics®, Sea Buckthorn Oil, Natural Vitamin E and Aloe vera has provided
some of Nature’s most healing gifts to support women to be healed, revitalized, and rejuvenated
throughout their lifetime. Hygeena is a totally pure and and natural product. It is gluten-free,
hormone-free and estrogen-free. It does NOT contain any boric acid, petrochemicals, parabens, BHT,
T.E.A, M.E.A, urea, glycols, PEG’s, etc.

[ Why use Glutathione?
][52]

Aging Defence: People who live to into their 80s and beyond are found to have higher levels of
glutathione. Often called the “master” antioxidant, glutathione boosts the utilization and recycling
of other antioxidants, namely vitamins C and E, as well as alpha lipoic acid and CoQ10. Low levels

plays at the cellular and mitochondrial levels, the overall health and longevity benefits are vast
and wide. Long story short, the more glutathione you have in your body, the healthier your cells and
mitochondria. Both EDTA and Glutathione are poorly absorbed when taken orally. But now, with this
powerful formula, you can get all the powerful benefits of both EDTA and Glutathione at the highest
level. You see, bio-availability is the key to performance.

][53]

absorbed oral chelation. With significant and efficient long-lasting EDTA blood levels and
three-fold EDTA tissue saturation it enables more efficient deep tissue heavy metal clearance.
Detoxamin EDTA Suppositories are backed by four scientific and clinical studies that have clearly
proven scientifically its safety and medical similarity to IV EDTA chelation.

dosage form is gentle and appears to create little biological burden and is very well tolerated. To
date, millions of doses have been administered worldwide.

  molecules in the lab to scaled-up output in the pilot workshop, every step embodies the ultimate
  pursuit of "green, efficacy, and safety." The delegation highly recognized the company's
  breakthroughs in plant active ingredient extraction and bio-fermentation technology, viewing these
  achievements as the exact "hard technological currency" urgently needed by the current cosmetics
  industry. Focusing on Collaborative Innovation, Discussing Pathways for Cooperation During the

  ingredient industry has shifted from individual products to a contest of technological ecosystems,

  application." Based on this, the two parties explored several substantive cooperation concepts,

Our commitment to affordability is unwavering. We leverage long-standing manufacturer partnerships
and bulk procurement strength to deliver competitive pricing at scale. Every purchase aligns with
our promise of compliance, reliability, and consistent quality—helping healthcare providers maintain
cost efficiency without compromise.


#### Commitment to Innovation

By investing in advanced technology, Drugzone streamlines ordering, tracking, and compliance.
Healthcare partners—from specialty clinics to hospital chains—benefit from secure, efficient, and
transparent operations. Our integrated ERP and compliance monitoring systems enhance real-time
visibility, inventory accuracy, and traceability throughout the supply chain.

Long-term relationships drive our success. Drugzone works closely with hospitals, LTC providers, and
specialty networks—listening to their needs and delivering solutions that help them serve their
patients better. Our dedicated account managers provide personalized support, ensuring every partner
experiences responsive communication, consistent supply, and measurable value from our
collaboration.

## Comprehensive Distribution Capabilities

Drugzone combines industry expertise with strong logistics to provide comprehensive generic
distribution services. Each capability is designed to help healthcare and specialty partners
maintain a safe, seamless, and cost-effective supply chain.

### Wholesale& Specialty Distribution

Reliable, nationwide generic pharmaceutical supply for healthcare and specialty care providers
across the U.S. Our consistent processes make us a trusted choice among wholesale pharmaceutical
distributors in the U.S.

State-of-the-art warehouses and a nationwide delivery network ensure secure storage and timely
shipments, reducing inventory gaps for healthcare networks nationwide.

and maintain an uninterrupted treatment supply.

checks to ensure healthcare providers—across human and animal health—receive authentic and traceable
products.

leading generic manufacturers. These strategic alliances ensure verified authenticity, stable

reliable access to quality pharmaceuticals across the U.S. under NABP, FDA, and DSCSA 2025

formulations. Each product is stored and distributed following the strictest compliance standards.

## Mission & Vision

[img]

### Mission

To advance healthcare delivery by ensuring access to safe, effective, and affordable generic
pharmaceuticals through innovation, compliance, and service excellence. Drugzone is committed to
empowering healthcare providers—hospitals, long-term care facilities, specialty clinics, and
veterinary networks—through transparent operations, ethical sourcing, and nationwide reliability.
* **Our mission focuses on:**
* Ensuring secure, compliant, and traceable pharmaceutical distribution across all 50 states.
* Maintaining ethical and transparent partnerships with healthcare providers and manufacturers.
* Promoting innovation in logistics, compliance, and digital fulfillment for greater efficiency.
* Upholding regulatory integrity through NABP, FDA, and DSCSA 2025 compliance.
* Creating long-term value by prioritizing patient safety and partner trust.

[img]

### Vision

To be among the nation’s most trusted pharmaceutical distribution companies, defined by integrity,
professionalism, and continuous innovation. Drugzone envisions a future where compliant and
affordable access to quality pharmaceuticals strengthens the entire continuum of care.
* **Our vision aspires to:**
* Lead the U.S. market as a benchmark in generic pharmaceutical distribution.
* Advance technology-driven operations that enhance fulfillment speed and traceability.
* Build sustainable business practices that support healthcare accessibility nationwide.
* Foster a partner-first culture rooted in transparency and responsiveness.
* Continue setting new standards of reliability and trust across human and animal health sectors.

across the U.S. receive authentic, safe, and timely pharmaceutical supply.

ensure timely and compliant deliveries, reducing wait times and helping you maintain optimal

#### Best Pricing in the Industry

Our commitment to affordability is unwavering. We leverage long-standing manufacturer partnerships
and bulk procurement strength to deliver competitive pricing at scale. Every purchase aligns with
our promise of compliance, reliability, and consistent quality—helping healthcare providers maintain
cost efficiency without compromise.


#### Commitment to Innovation

By investing in advanced technology, Drugzone streamlines ordering, tracking, and compliance.
Healthcare partners—from specialty clinics to hospital chains—benefit from secure, efficient, and
transparent operations. Our integrated ERP and compliance monitoring systems enhance real-time
visibility, inventory accuracy, and traceability throughout the supply chain.


#### Partner-Centric Approach

Long-term relationships drive our success. Drugzone works closely with hospitals, LTC providers, and
specialty networks—listening to their needs and delivering solutions that help them serve their
patients better. Our dedicated account managers provide personalized support, ensuring every partner
experiences responsive communication, consistent supply, and measurable value from our
collaboration.

## Comprehensive Distribution Capabilities

Drugzone combines industry expertise with strong logistics to provide comprehensive generic
distribution services. Each capability is designed to help healthcare and specialty partners
maintain a safe, seamless, and cost-effective supply chain.

across the U.S. Our consistent processes make us a trusted choice among wholesale pharmaceutical
distributors in the U.S.

shipments, reducing inventory gaps for healthcare networks nationwide.

and maintain an uninterrupted treatment supply.

checks to ensure healthcare providers—across human and animal health—receive authentic and traceable
products.

## Mission & Vision

[img]

### Mission

To advance healthcare delivery by ensuring access to safe, effective, and affordable generic
pharmaceuticals through innovation, compliance, and service excellence. Drugzone is committed to
empowering healthcare providers—hospitals, long-term care facilities, specialty clinics, and
veterinary networks—through transparent operations, ethical sourcing, and nationwide reliability.
* **Our mission focuses on:**
* Ensuring secure, compliant, and traceable pharmaceutical distribution across all 50 states.
* Maintaining ethical and transparent partnerships with healthcare providers and manufacturers.
* Promoting innovation in logistics, compliance, and digital fulfillment for greater efficiency.
* Upholding regulatory integrity through NABP, FDA, and DSCSA 2025 compliance.
* Creating long-term value by prioritizing patient safety and partner trust.

[img]

### Vision

To be among the nation’s most trusted pharmaceutical distribution companies, defined by integrity,
professionalism, and continuous innovation. Drugzone envisions a future where compliant and
affordable access to quality pharmaceuticals strengthens the entire continuum of care.
* **Our vision aspires to:**
* Lead the U.S. market as a benchmark in generic pharmaceutical distribution.
* Advance technology-driven operations that enhance fulfillment speed and traceability.
* Build sustainable business practices that support healthcare accessibility nationwide.
* Foster a partner-first culture rooted in transparency and responsiveness.
* Continue setting new standards of reliability and trust across human and animal health sectors.

across the U.S. receive authentic, safe, and timely pharmaceutical supply.
